categories.main_business_segments: KRAFTON, Inc. primarily operates in game development and publishing, offering a portfolio of games including PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, NEW STATE Mobile, and Subnautica across PC, mobile, and console platforms. The company also engages in adjacent businesses such as blockchain, media content production (film, drama, music, webtoons), education services, and management consulting. It operates multiple in-house and subsidiary studios focusing on diverse game genres including battle royale, MMORPG, casual sports, action, and strategy games.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: KRAFTON leverages advanced game development technologies including AI and deep learning to innovate gameplay and creative production methods. The company employs multi-platform conversion technology to optimize games for PC, mobile, and console. It also integrates blockchain and metaverse technologies through joint ventures to develop decentralized digital asset ecosystems. The production process involves global collaboration among 12 studios with shared code systems and developer knowledge networks to enhance creativity and technical capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are global gamers across over 200 countries, with a strong presence in Asia, North America, and Europe. It serves diverse gamer segments through PC, mobile, and console platforms, with a significant focus on mobile users, especially in emerging markets like India. KRAFTON also targets esports audiences and partners with influencers and streaming platforms to expand its reach. Additionally, it serves media consumers through its IP-based content in film, music, and webtoons.
categories.geographic_coverage: KRAFTON operates globally with significant revenue generated from overseas markets, accounting for approximately 95% of total sales. Key regions include Asia (notably India), North America, Europe, and emerging markets such as the Middle East and Africa. The company maintains development studios and subsidiaries in South Korea, the United States, Canada, Sweden, the Czech Republic, and other countries, supporting localized game development and publishing.
categories.supply_chain_position: KRAFTON operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the gaming supply chain, focusing on game development (content creation) and publishing (distribution and live operations). It manages the entire lifecycle from IP creation, game production, marketing, live service, to esports event organization. The company also invests in upstream technology development such as AI and blockchain to enhance its products and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include scaling up creative IPs, especially expanding the PUBG franchise across multiple platforms and genres. It emphasizes R&D in AI and deep learning to innovate gameplay and virtual game friends. KRAFTON is expanding into blockchain and metaverse ecosystems via joint ventures, and diversifying into media content production leveraging its game IPs. It also focuses on emerging markets like India for growth and invests in new studios and technologies to sustain long-term innovation.
categories.revenue_model: KRAFTON generates revenue primarily through game sales and in-game monetization including in-app purchases and season passes. The PC and console versions of PUBG transitioned to a free-to-play model supplemented by paid in-game items. Mobile games rely heavily on microtransactions. Additional revenue streams include esports sponsorships, broadcasting rights, merchandise sales, and licensing of IP for media content. The company also earns from education services and management consulting related to its subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KRAFTON is positioned as a leading global game developer and publisher with a strong mega IP in PUBG, competing with major global players in the gaming industry. Its competitors include other large game companies with multi-platform offerings and strong IP portfolios. KRAFTON differentiates itself through its global development network, advanced AI integration, and diversified content expansion into media and blockchain. It maintains a competitive edge by combining in-house development with strategic investments and acquisitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, KRAFTON reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.91 trillion KRW (~1.6 billion USD), with a 3.1% year-over-year growth. The company’s operating profit was about 768 billion KRW, and net income increased by 18.8% to 594 billion KRW. It holds total assets of 6.44 trillion KRW and equity of 5.56 trillion KRW, reflecting a strong financial position with a low debt ratio of 15.9%. The company has shown steady growth driven by its flagship IP and expanding global footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KRAFTON’s unique value proposition lies in its globally recognized mega IP PUBG, offering differentiated gameplay experiences across multiple platforms with continuous content updates. Its advanced AI and deep learning capabilities enable innovative game features and virtual player interactions. The company’s global development studios foster diverse creativity and technical excellence. Additionally, KRAFTON’s expansion into blockchain, metaverse, and media content production creates a comprehensive entertainment ecosystem, enhancing IP value and user engagement.
